t: This is the Skempton Building, home of civil engineering at Imperial College London. It is named for Sir Alec Skempton, an English civil engineer recognised, alongside Karl Terzaghi, as a founding father of soil mechanics. He set up the soil mechanics course at Imperial, and the department's building was renamed after him in 2004. He was knighted in the 2000 New Year Honours for services to engineering, and he also contributed to the history of British civil engineering.
